messages:
incident-bot: Paging: High error rate (502/504) observed for inference endpoints routed to us-west-2a. Impact: intermittent inference failures and increased tail latency for hosted customers. Trigger: latency > 1.5s and errors > 1% for 10m. Pager: alice.
alice: seeing spikes on the dashboard now, many requests timing out at ~2s then 502s. Affects both text-gen and embeddings in that AZ.
ben: confirm, logs show TCP retransmits from nodes in us-west-2a and NLB health checks flapping. Example from one node: 
```
[2026-03-15T14:04:12Z] WARN request timeout id=abcd1234 target=10.0.4.23 conn-reset
[2026-03-15T14:04:15Z] ERROR backend 10.0.4.23 failed: EOF
```

carla: AWS console shows ENI packet drops and elevated host network errors for a subset of instances in us-west-2a. Also seeing AZ capacity throttling in some instance types.
alice: impact: ~8% of inference traffic routed to us-west-2a is failing. Customers on shared-hosted endpoints see errors. Dedicated pools in the AZ also show degraded throughput.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment for model rwt-large currently paused due to health check failures in us-west-2a.
megan: I have two paying customers currently reporting production errors (CUST-42 and CUST-88). Drafting initial incident message for status page. Need ETA for mitigation so I can include next update.
josh: immediate plan: 1) Turn on AZ-avoid routing for new requests to skip us-west-2a. 2) Force local failover for in-flight requests where possible. 3) Scale up capacity in us-west-2b and eu-west-1 to absorb traffic. 4) Open AWS support case for network fabric in us-west-2a.
alice: do it. Ben/Carla -- can you confirm which node groups to drain and any pinned ded pools?
ben: listing affected ASGs: inference-g5-usw2a-1, inference-g4dn-usw2a-2. Two dedicated pools pinned by contracts: dp-cust42-usw2a (cust-42), dp-cust88-usw2a (cust-88). We need to avoid rolling those without approvals, but we can activate cross-AZ failover for them.
carla: starting targeted drain of 3 nodes showing highest retransmits. Command run: `aws ec2 terminate-instances --instance-ids i-0abcde12345 i-0fghij67890` (only for degraded nodes). NOTE: not draining whole ASG. Also increasing desired count in inference-g5-usw2b by +6.
alice: josh, can you patch the routing policy? We have smart routing flags. Set prefer_az to exclude us-west-2a and lower weight to 0 for that AZ.
josh: doing now. Config snippet I'm applying: 
```
routes.smart_routing.update({
  "us-west-2a": {"weight":0, "reason":"az-network-degradation"},
  "us-west-2b": {"weight":70},
  "eu-west-1": {"weight":30}
})
```
Applying...
josh: applied. New traffic distribution should propagate in ~45s.
ben: NLB health checks still flapping on some targets in 2a. I'm adjusting health check grace to 20s to reduce churn while we migrate traffic out.
aws-support-bot: AWS Support case 123456789 opened: "us-west-2 - potential AZ network impairment affecting EC2 instances and ENIs". Severity: high. Case owner: AWS-Network-Team.
megan: status update to customers: "We're investigating elevated errors for inference endpoints routed to us-west-2a. We're routing new traffic away from the AZ and scaling capacity elsewhere. No customer data loss. More updates in 30 minutes." Any objections?
alice: good. Send it. Add that we have an AWS case open.
megan: posted to status page and emailed CUST-42/88 directly with note about cross-AZ failover being enabled.
josh: started cross-AZ failover for pinned dedicated pools: dp-cust42 -> failover to dp-cust42-usw2b, dp-cust88 -> dp-cust88-eu1 (temporary). Per contract, will keep owner informed.
ben: I'm seeing 10% of traffic still hitting the AZ due to cached route prefixes at some edge nodes. Running cache invalidation: `curl -X POST https://internal-routing/flush -d '{"az":"us-west-2a"}'`
carla: confirmed flush propagated. Metrics show error rate dropping from 1.2% -> 0.12% over last 8 minutes for overall API. Tail latency improved.
alice: next: monitor for 30m. If AWS confirms fabric issue, we'll keep AZ excluded until resolved. Also we need a timeline to restore and a follow-up postmortem owner.
aws-support-bot: AWS update at 14:22Z: "We are seeing high packet drops on some physical network links in us-west-2a. Engineers are investigating. No ETA yet."
megan: customers acknowledged. CUST-42: asked for rollback contingency — they are satisfied with cross-AZ failover for now.
josh: some internal observability notes: KV cache invalidation needed because some sessions pinned to nodes that are now drained. I'm invalidating KV cache for affected model-runtimes to prevent 502s for resumed requests. Command: `POST /admin/cache/invalidate?prefix=model-rwt`
ben: check for elevated request retries causing billing anomalies. I've applied a temporary rule to de-duplicate retries originating from our API gateway to avoid double charging customers until we've stabilized.
alice: who is taking postmortem? Need owner and timeline for write-up.
carla: I'll own the infrastructure portion (what degraded and why). Ben can own the on-call mitigation timeline. Josh for runtime failover decisions. Megan for customer comms. I'll create a postmortem doc and assign action items.
deploy-bot: Alert: paused rollout rwt-large remains paused until health checks clear and us-west-2a is either healthy or excluded.
alice: current health: errors back down to baseline for most customers, dedicated failovers successful, routing excludes us-west-2a. Continue monitoring.
megan: sending scheduled customer update in 25m to say we've mitigated and are investigating root cause with AWS.
josh: follow-up: once AWS resolves, we'll run a staged inclusion: 1) small percentage traffic 2) monitor health 3) full weight. We'll coordinate with infra before re-enabling.
carla: AWS case updated: "Network team confirmed flapping on multiple ENIs caused by degraded host switch. Patch applied to affected racks; monitoring for stability."
alice: closing on-call handoff: ben, you'll take the overnight watch for stabilization, then hand back to carla in morning for remediation tasks.
ben: acknowledged. I'll keep an eye on latency and NLB health checks for the next 4 hours.
megan: final customer update sent: "Mitigation complete: traffic routed away from impacted AZ, affected dedicated pools failed over, AWS investigating. No data loss. Next update within 24h with root cause and remediation steps."
alice: good job team. Postmortem owners: carla (infra), ben (oncall timeline), josh (runtime), megan (comm). I'll kick off incident timeline doc now.
carla: created postmortem draft: /docs/incidents/1850009876-west2a-network-saturation-inference-failover.md. Will add evidence and timelines.
alice: thread resolved for paging, keeping it open for postmortem notes. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
